name: generate_variants
description: Generates design variants of an existing spread using REFINE (strict Swiss baseline alignment), EXPLORE (alternative complementary archetype), or REIMAGINE (radical editorial re-composition).

spreadId.description: Target spread ID to generate variants for.

creativeRange.description: Creative range: REFINE (subtle grid tuning), EXPLORE (different archetype), REIMAGINE (radical dark atelier/full-bleed re-composition).

variantCount.description: Number of variants to produce (1-4). Defaults to 3.
